name: Atlassian Suite
description: Manages Atlassian credentials (email, Jira base URL, Bitbucket workspace, per-product API tokens in SecretStorage) and exposes live Jira/Bitbucket REST probes that power ticket-existence checks, open-PR lookups, and token validation.

email.label: Atlassian Email
email.description: Email address tied to your Atlassian account. Used to authenticate live Jira and Bitbucket API requests — ticket verification and PR lookups run against this identity. The API token paired with this email is stored separately in VS Code's SecretStorage and managed from this module's panel — it is not entered here.

jiraBase.label: Jira Base URL
jiraBase.description: Base URL used to form Jira ticket links: <jiraBase>/browse/<KEY>. Trailing slashes are stripped automatically. Change this if your Atlassian instance lives at a non-default domain.

bitbucketWorkspace.label: Bitbucket Workspace
bitbucketWorkspace.description: Bitbucket Cloud workspace slug used as a fallback when the local repo's git remote URL cannot be parsed. Normally auto-detected from origin's URL; this value only takes effect when auto-detection fails.
